title: Sources & further reading
body:
Researched 2026-08-28 for the Oct 20-23, 2026 trip. Primary sources fetched directly during this pass:

  • Hanagasa Bus (Ginzan Line) — the anchor transfer's operator
  • Risshaku-ji (Yamadera) official site
  • Ginzan Onsen official lodging directory
  • Ginzan Onsen vehicle-access notices
  • Yonezawa Beef Tokiwa, Yamagata store
  • Soba Sanbyakubou (Beninokura)
  • Yamagata City — Kajo Park
  • Bunshokan
  • Japan National Tourism Organization — visa information

⚠ JR East's own fare and timetable pages (jreast.co.jp), Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (mofa.go.jp), and the US State Department's travel advisory page (travel.state.gov) were all bot-gated (HTTP 403) against automated fetch throughout this research pass — figures drawn from them are corroborated via independent secondary sources instead and flagged ⚠ in the relevant sections. Re-confirm directly before booking or travel.
